name: orient-cameras
description: Fix the gauge (gravity/floor, z-up). @1 = bootstrap-mesh multi-plane RANSAC + camera-consensus up prior + cameras-above-floor check (STO-SCN-089-2: @0's largest-plane fit picked a wall on corridor captures and rolled the gauge 90deg; the operator-guided 'average camera up' prior, lost in the 082 sparse-method rejection, is restored in roll-robust form — each camera votes its 4 lateral axes). @2: bootstrap mesh is a resolved input; z-floor computed on the solve-framed mesh (gauge-sim composed).

method.note: MEASURED 2026-06-11 (STO-SCN-082): floor-ransac-sparse REJECTED. bootstrap-mesh adopted; @1 adds the up prior (STO-SCN-089-2).

up_prior.note: up = eigvec_min(sum X_i X_i^T): photographers pitch freely but keep the horizon level, so image-right is horizontal in every shot — pitch never biases the estimate (mean(-Y) was 35-40deg off on 009's path shots). Straight-walk null space disambiguated by projected mean(-Y); portrait via Y-axis horizon; refuses on >15deg horizon inconsistency (mixed rolls) or non-person camera height.
